comment: Expected verdicts for the ACE differential probes (scripts/ace-differential/run.js).
'ace' is what IBM ACE 13.0.9.0 (EVALUATION) esqllangbuilder does with the file;
'ts' is what the tree-sitter grammar does. 'class' says WHY the two agree or
disagree. Re-adjudicate a row only against the ACE 12.0.x railroad diagrams

probes.note: module header carries NO ';' — ACE rejects one, see no_mod_header_trailing_semi
routine body closes with END;
multi-name DECLARE is legal at module level
DECLARE a, b INTEGER; inside a routine
alias form DECLARE p NAMESPACE 'uri'; (no datatype)
alias form DECLARE s NAME 'Joe'; (no datatype)
quoted DECLARE names are legal (family H confirmed against the compiler)
bare REFERENCE params OK; REFERENCE TO <tree> is not, see no_param_reference_to
CONSTANT IN parameter
OUT DECIMAL without precision; DECIMAL(p,s) in a signature is not, see no_param_decimal_precision
canonical multi-condition list — each condition carries its own SQLSTATE keyword; the old rule only allowed the keyword once. Found by this differential (2026-10-29)
named SET clauses REQUIRE '=' — see no_set_type_space
MOVE source is a declared variable; a THE-rooted path is not, see no_move_rooted_source
bare LOG — VALUES is optional. This is the issue-9 fix validated against the real compiler
FULL requires EXCEPTION — see no_log_event_full
SELECT COUNT(*) scalar subquery; SUM/MAX/MIN are not builtins, see no_select_aggregate_sum
INSERT without WHERE tail, see no_insert_where
bare 'DECLARE iv INTERVAL;' (qualifier-less datatype) compiles on ACE 13; the old rule made the qualifier mandatory. Found by this differential (2026-10-29)
ACE 13: ';' after the module header is a syntax error. The 12.0.x module diagram shows the terminator optional, so the grammar keeps it optional
ACE 13 REQUIRES ';' after END MODULE (hint: 'Valid options include: ;'). Diagram shows it optional; an unterminated module is also the normal state of a buffer being typed
ACE 13 REQUIRES ';' after a routine-body END. Same reasoning as END MODULE
pre-ACE legacy datatype family: compiled by ACE 12, removed in 13. Grammar keeps it (E-2-style adjudication); the server's deprecated-type hint carries strictness
NAMEVALUE removed in ACE 13
LOGICAL removed in ACE 13 (VERIFICATION.md E-3)
ACE 13: 'Statements are not allowed in function or procedure scope' — SHARED variables are module-level only. Analyzer hint candidate
NAMESPACE/NAME clauses attach to the ALIAS declares (no datatype), not to a scalar datatype. Analyzer hint candidate
same family as no_declare_scalar_namespace_clause
REFERENCE TO <tree> in a signature: ACE 13 says 'Syntax error in function or procedure signature'; bare REFERENCE is the 13 form
DECIMAL(p,s) parameter datatype rejected by ACE 13 (signature hint lists only ') , NOT NULLABLE')
LIKE/ESCAPE handler conditions documented on the 11.x/12.x pages; ACE 13 accepts only SQLSTATE conditions (hint: 'Valid options include: SQLSTATE.'). Corpus case kept permissive
VALUE <number> condition: neither ACE 13 nor the grammar accepts it (VALUE attaches to a quoted sqlstate string, not an integer)
SET <path> TYPE 'x' (no '='): ACE 13 hint is 'Valid options include: ='. Family G2. Analyzer hint candidate
same for the NAMESPACE and VALUE clauses (probes q13/q13 round: VALUE/NAME space forms also rejected)
BIT '…' typed literal shown on the 12.0.x expression page; ACE 13 accepts typed literals only for DATE/TIME/TIMESTAMP/GMTTIME/GMTTIMESTAMP/INTERVAL
CHAR '…' typed literal, same family as BIT
INSERT … WHERE tail: on the 12.0.x INSERT railroad, rejected by ACE 13 (hint: 'Valid options include: ;')
SELECT ITEM SUM(...) → 'Incorrect function or procedure name "SUM" or argument count' — SUM/MAX/MIN are not SELECT builtins on ACE 13 (COUNT is). Name-table-checkable hint candidate
FULL requires EXCEPTION on ACE 13 (hint: 'Valid options include: EXCEPTION'); the LOG diagram lists the clauses independently
same family: 'LOG USER TRACE FULL' without EXCEPTION
'Valid options include: EXCEPTION' — FULL is only legal with EXCEPTION; VALUES alone is fine (ok_log_user_trace_values)
LOG USER TRACE VALUES (...) is legal; it is the FULL-without-EXCEPTION tail that ACE 13 rejects. (First harness run corrected an earlier misreading — the probe pair here encodes the verified split)

leading-dot schema path: 'Syntax error in schema declaration' on ACE 13. A plain 'BROKER SCHEMA mft.S2' passes PARSE and fails semantically ('Incorrect schema name') — that half is not a grammar concern

module kind keyword (COMPUTE/DATABASE/…) after CREATE is mandatory — ACE hint lists the kinds. This closes the issue-9 open item 'bare CREATE MODULE': the 12.0.x page was unreachable, the compiler settles it (2026-10-29)
plural interval qualifier (INTERVAL '5' DAYS) — ACE hint 'DAY HOUR MINUTE MONTH SECOND YEAR' (singular only). Closes the other issue-9 open item

MOVE source must be a declared variable (or THE expression): 'MOVE OutputRoot… TO …' → hint 'FIRSTCHILD LASTCHILD NEXTSIBLING …'. The 12.0.x MOVE railroad shows a field reference, so the grammar stays permissive; analyzer hint candidate
